tokyo_raamen_men_maru.price_note: No dish and no price. The shop has no site of its own — the stored link is its entry in the 浅草ひさご通り商店街 shopping-street directory, which was fetched and read in full and carries only the address (台東区浅草2-15-2), the opening hours (weekdays 10:00–16:00, weekends 9:00–18:00) and blank fields for telephone and closing day. There is no menu, no price and no photograph of a board. Tabelog not consulted: Cf-Mitigated: challenge (403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. ⚠ NOTHING ABOUT WHAT IT SERVES IS RECORDED. The shop name contains らぁめん, and this dataset has repeatedly established that a noodle word in a shop name settles nothing a coeliac needs — 中華そば means ramen, 沖縄そば contains no buckwheat, やきそば is wheat, and the tare is a separate question from the noodle. Reading a diet flag off a shop name is the same error as reading one off a cuisine type. Re-check when Tabelog access returns.

tokyo_withgreen_shibuya_dogenz.price_note: ⚠ THIS IS ONE OF THE BEST ALLERGEN DISCLOSURES IN THE DATASET AND, UNUSUALLY, IT DELIVERS GOOD NEWS. WithGreen publishes a dated per-item table against Japan's full 28 特定原材料等 list (sheet dated 2026/9/1), covering every salad, every topping, every dressing and every soup separately — and it is machine-readable, not a photograph. Prices, ingredients and per-item nutrition are on the chain menu page; the 道玄坂通 branch is at 渋谷区道玄坂2-25-12 道玄坂通 1F, 10:00-21:00 daily (eat-in L.O. 20:30, takeout to close), 12 seats, five minutes from Shibuya station. Every salad comes in S/M/L. ⚠ THE HEADLINE: １日分のまるごとサラダ AT S¥1,360 / M¥1,430 / L¥1,560 CARRIES NOT ONE MARK IN ANY OF THE 28 COLUMNS. Carrot, daikon, tomato, red cabbage, cucumber, corn, grilled potato and onion — 350 g of vegetables, no declared allergen at all, and no animal ingredient in the list. Pair it with レモンドレッシング, which is likewise blank across all 28 columns, and you have a complete plant-only meal with nothing declared — which is close to unheard-of on a Japanese high street. ⚠ THE CRITICAL CATCH, IN THE SHOP'S OWN WORDS, AND IT IS WHY NOTHING HERE IS MARKED gf OUTRIGHT: the sheet ends 「・トッピングが混入するコンタミネーションの可能性がありますため、表記のアレルゲンにつきましては保証しかねます」 — toppings may be carried across during assembly and the declared allergens are therefore NOT guaranteed. This is a build-to-order salad counter where wheat-containing items (きんぴらごぼう, 砂肝, 棒棒鶏, レッドチリチキン, キーマカレー, ローストポーク and the パン) are handled on the same line with the same tongs. The table tells you what is IN each component; it explicitly does not promise what stays out of your bowl. ⚠ SECOND CATCH, EASY TO MISS: the salad table is headed サラダ（ドレッシング抜き） — the salad rows EXCLUDE the dressing, and dressings are listed separately with their own allergens. Your actual plate is salad + dressing, and the dressing is where most of the wheat is: ゆず醤油 declares 小麦, 柑橘 declares 小麦, オニオン declares 小麦, ジンジャー declares 小麦, ごまクリーミー declares 小麦, シーザー declares 小麦 and ナッツ declares 小麦. Seven of the thirteen dressings are wheat. A wheat-free salad plus the recommended dressing is frequently NOT a wheat-free plate — 甘辛きんぴらごぼうと玄米のサラダ is recommended with ジンジャー, and both of them declare wheat. ⚠ THE THREE SALADS WHOSE OWN ROW DECLARES NO WHEAT are 蒸し鶏とりんごのサラダ (milk, chicken, apple), タンドリーチキンと北海道産じゃがいもグリルのサラダ (egg, milk, soy, chicken, apple) and たっぷりスモークチキンのシーザーサラダ (soy and chicken ONLY — a caesar salad with neither wheat nor dairy declared in the salad itself, which is genuinely surprising; the シーザードレッシング it is sold with declares 卵・乳・小麦・落花生, so the wheat arrives with the dressing, not the bowl). Plus the marumaru salad, which declares nothing. ⚠ FOR A VEGAN the plain toppings are the whole story and they are unusually clean: 人参, 大根, オニオン, 紫キャベツ, トマト, きゅうり, コーン, さつまいも, 玄米, じゃがいもグリル, 塩麹しめじ and 柿 all carry ZERO marks — note 塩麹しめじ declares no soy, so the shio-koji is rice-based. 豆腐 declares soy only and もやしナムル soy and sesame. Four dressings — ハニーマスタード, ハニーミルク and the two marked 「※原材料の一部にはちみつを含みます」 — contain honey, and several salads carry the same honey footnote, so a strict vegan should read that line as carefully as the allergen columns. カスタムサラダ from ¥990 lets you pick five standard toppings, which is the practical way to build a clean plate.
